data.content:
* * *

## [Do not buy!!](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64696de0734f97e68fb5d271)
I ordered the Kashmiri rug which your website said was 8' wide. Once it came in, it was actually 7' wide. I had issues with returning it but was told that I had to bring the huge rug to FedEx even though I don't have a car, before I could get my refund. This was not my mistake to correct. On top of that, the rep who was assisting me, Dianamarie, completely stopped responding to my emails. I'm so frustrated with this store! I place a lot of orders and I'm very annoyed that this is the type of customer support that you provide.

May 6, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 22, 2023

Hi Shanice,

Thank you for your feedback and we're sorry to hear this rug did not meet your expectations. For this reason, a full refund has been issued back for this return. Our rep will contact you at her earliest convenience for any further questions or concerns, you may have. We appreciate your patience.
